statement.p: Calculate the line integral of the vector field \vec F=-3\,\mathit{\vec i}-4\,\mathit{\vec j} along the line from the point \left(1,0\right) to the point \left(8,0\right).

static.solution:
\vec F is a constant vector field and the curve is a line, \int_C\vec F\cdot \,d \vec r= \vec F\cdot \Delta \vec r, where \Delta \vec r = 7 \vec i. Therefore,
\int_C\vec F\cdot \,d \vec r= ( -3\,\mathit{\vec i}-4\,\mathit{\vec j} ) \cdot 7 \vec i = -21.
